$comment: Reviewed rule overlaps (bin/similar.mjs --check). A pair scoring at or above the threshold must be listed here with why both rules stay — otherwise merge them (one fact, one owner). Stale entries fail the check too.

accepted.SHR-1~CLEAN-13: pointer: CLEAN-13's solution order names SHR-1 for the second caller; SHR-1 owns the rule
accepted.WEB-2~OPS-7: pointer: OPS-7 (all endpoints, SHOULD) defers certificate-expiry alerting to WEB-2 (websites, MUST)

accepted.AUTH-4~WEB-22: refinement: AUTH-4 requires passkeys be offered; WEB-22 adds the conditional-UI SHOULD
accepted.AGT-11~CLEAN-8: pointer to REPO-1 (ADRs) in both; REPO-1 owns the ADR rule
accepted.AGT-12~CLEAN-8: pointer to REPO-1 (ADRs) in both; REPO-1 owns the ADR rule
accepted.CLEAN-8~REPO-1: pointer: CLEAN-8 defers ADRs to REPO-1

accepted.PERF-6~PERF-27: split by level: PERF-6 SHOULD (cache hygiene) points to PERF-27 MUST (no cross-tenant cache)
